# This script sets up the necessary tools for memory monitoring

    apt-get update -qq > /dev/null 2>&1

fi

EOF

cat > /app/calculate_memory_usage.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Script to calculate the percentage of used memory
# This script will output an integer representing the memory usage percentage

# First, run the initialization script
/app/init_monitoring.sh > /dev/null 2>&1

# Get total memory and used memory using free command
# free -m shows memory in megabytes
TOTAL_MEM=$(free -m | grep -i mem | awk '{print $2}')
USED_MEM=$(free -m | grep -i mem | awk '{print $3}')

# Calculate the percentage: (used / total) * 100
# Using awk for integer arithmetic
PERCENTAGE=$(echo "$USED_MEM $TOTAL_MEM" | awk '{printf "%d", ($1 / $2) * 100}')

# Output the result as an integer
echo "$PERCENTAGE"
EOF
